versions.content: The verification functions shall provide KEYM_E_CERT_SIGNATURE_FAIL through callback functions if the signature verification fails.

If the certificate format type contains a time period, the KeyM module shall query the current time from configured time source (KeyMCertTimebaseRef) and compare the current time if it is within the validity period of the certificate. If not, the certificate status KEYM_E_CERTIFICATE_VALIDITY_PERIOD_FAIL shall be set and reported through callback function (if configured) and the validation process shall stop. Otherwise, the check outlined in [SWS_KEYM_00035] shall be performed at next.
